risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (226), and earnings event in 28 days create compounded downside risk despite falling USD benefiting utilities.

debate.key_bull_argument: Multi-timeframe bullish structure (price above EMA200, Supertrend bullish, Ichimoku above cloud, EMA 9/21 and SMA 20/50 aligned) with contrarian buy signal in extreme fear zone (VIX 226) offers asymmetric risk/reward at support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Negative MACD histogram, weak ADX (29.37 = moderate not strong), no crossover confirmation, zero fundamental catalysts, high earnings risk in 28 days, and inverted yield curve recession signal create compounded downside risk that outweighs technical alignment.
